# DuckDuckGo

7 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 6 standard (1 credit), 1 advanced (5) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/duckduckgo/images - 1 credit (standard)

Returns DuckDuckGo Images results with the image, thumbnail, size, source page and domain, filterable by size, colour, type, layout and licence.

**Use when** you want to find images for a topic, or to narrow to a license such as share_commercially.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - One results page per call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, for example nike logo. · e.g. `nike logo`
- `region` (optional, string) - Region code such as us-en, uk-en or de-de (64 codes), or wt-wt for no region. Default us-en.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any, day, week, month or year.
- `size` (optional, enum: small | medium | large | wallpaper) - small, medium, large or wallpaper.
- `color` (optional, string) - color, monochrome, or one of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, brown, black, gray, teal or white.
- `type` (optional, enum: photo | clipart | gif | transparent | line) - photo, clipart, gif, transparent or line.
- `layout` (optional, enum: square | tall | wide) - square, tall or wide.
- `license` (optional, enum: any | public | share | share_commercially | modify | modify_commercially) - any, public, share, share_commercially, modify or modify_commercially.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Images to return, 1 to 30. Default 30.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {position number, title string, image_url string, thumbnail_url string, width number, height number, source_page_url string, domain string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/duckduckgo/images" \
  --data-urlencode "query=nike logo" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/duckduckgo/instant-answer - 1 credit (standard)

Returns DuckDuckGo's instant answer for a topic: heading, summary and its source, image, a direct answer or definition, the official website and related topics.

**Use when** you want it for a quick factual summary of a person, company, or concept with a source to cite.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - A topic, for example Nike. · e.g. `Nike`

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): {query string, found boolean, type string, heading string, abstract null, abstract_source string, abstract_url string, image_url null, answer null, definition null, definition_source null, official_website null}; `related_topics[]` {text string, url string, group null}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/duckduckgo/instant-answer" \
  --data-urlencode "query=Nike" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/duckduckgo/news - 1 credit (standard)

Returns DuckDuckGo News articles with publisher, excerpt, publication time and image.

**Use when** you want to see how the press is covering a brand or topic right now.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - One results page per call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, for example nike. · e.g. `nike`
- `region` (optional, string) - Region code such as us-en, uk-en or de-de (64 codes), or wt-wt for no region. Default us-en.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any, day, week, month or year.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Articles to return, 1 to 30. Default 30.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {position number, title string, url string, source string, snippet string, published_at string, image_url string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/duckduckgo/news" \
  --data-urlencode "query=nike" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/duckduckgo/rank - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns whether a domain or a URL path ranks on DuckDuckGo for a search, its best position, and every matching result, scanning up to 200 positions in one call.

**Use when** you want to track where a site ranks for a keyword without reading through the result pages yourself.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search to check, for example best running shoes. · e.g. `best running shoes`
- `url` (required) - The site to look for: a domain (example.com, matching its subdomains) or a URL with a path (example.com/blog, matching pages under it). · e.g. `runnersworld.com`
- `region` (optional, string) - Region code such as us-en, uk-en or de-de (64 codes), or wt-wt for no region. Default us-en.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any, day, week, month or year.
- `depth` (optional, integer, 1-200) - Organic positions to scan, 1 to 200. Default 100. One call at any depth.
- `all_matches` (optional, boolean) - true to scan the whole depth and report every matching position. Default false (stop at the first results page with a match).
- `include_subdomains` (optional, boolean) - false to count only the exact domain. Default true.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): {query string, target string, found boolean, position number, depth number, depth_scanned number, end_of_results boolean}; `matches[]` {position number, url string, title string, page number}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/duckduckgo/rank" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running shoes" \
  --data-urlencode "url=runnersworld.com" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/duckduckgo/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns DuckDuckGo's organic results in order, each with its position (counting across pages), title, link, displayed address, domain, snippet and date, plus the zero-click summary box when DuckDuckGo shows one. Pass the returned cursor for the next page; DuckDuckGo lists about 200 results for a search at most.

**Use when** you want it for web results from a search engine outside Google. A search lists about 200 results at most.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · ≈10/page (observed once); set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/10) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, for example best running shoes. · e.g. `best running shoes`
- `region` (optional, string) - Region code such as us-en, uk-en or de-de (64 codes), or wt-wt for no region. Default us-en.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any, day, week, month or year.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Results to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {position number, title string, url string, displayed_url string, domain string, site_name null, snippet string, date null}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`, `data.zero_click`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/duckduckgo/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running shoes" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/duckduckgo/suggestions - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the completions DuckDuckGo suggests for a partial query.

**Use when** you want to see how people finish a search, for keyword ideas or autocomplete.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - One results page per call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - A partial search, for example best running sh. · e.g. `best running sh`
- `region` (optional, string) - Region code such as us-en, uk-en or de-de (64 codes), or wt-wt for no region. Default us-en.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ text }` (inferred from a sample): {text string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/duckduckgo/suggestions" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running sh" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
